messages:
sam: FYI hitting a parity gap between REST and dotnet-sdk on embeddings. REST accepts `return_raw_metadata` and sometimes returns 202+Location when downstream is slow. dotnet-sdk (v0.4.0) neither maps the flag nor treats 202 as accepted; it retries and we see duplicate indexing jobs in staging.

rhea: can you paste both calls? quick repro helps.

sam: curl (works):
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings/batch \ 
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"inputs":["s1"],"return_raw_metadata":true}'
```
returns 200 with metadata array or 202+Location when metadata service is slow.

sam: dotnet snippet: (library call)
```csharp
await client.Embeddings.Create(new EmbeddingsCreateRequest {
  Model = "open-embed-1",
  Inputs = new [] { "s1" },
  ReturnRawMetadata = true
});
```
no metadata and logs show two queue events job_900 then job_901.

ivan: likely two issues: 1) serializer uses `ReturnRawMetadata` but no `JsonProperty("return_raw_metadata")` tag so wire is `returnRawMetadata` which server rejects; 2) global retry treats non-200 as retryable, so 202 triggers retry. Also token refresh replay can amplify it.

rhea: propose: (A) add JsonProperty mapping for ReturnRawMetadata in dotnet models and unit that asserts payload contains `return_raw_metadata`; (B) add route-level retry policy so embeddings.batch treats 202 as terminal (queued) not retryable; (C) update auth middleware to avoid replaying POSTs that already returned 202; (D) bump sample-app default timeout from 10s to 30s.

sam: agree. I'll open two small PRs: dotnet-sdk#27 (serializer + test + changelog) and infra#403 (retry policy + auth replay tweak). Will also add an integration test in sample-app that mocks 202+Location and asserts only one job queued.

release-bot: patch window today at 18:00 UTC; tag PRs if they need to go in.

irvan: tiny nit: add a CONTRIBUTING note that SDKs should map camelCase -> snake_case on the wire for experimental flags. Keeps parity consistent.

sam: will add the note in dotnet-sdk PR. leaving thread open until PRs merged + CI green. :thumbsup:
